codes.title: Access revoked
codes.shopkeeper: Your access has been removed.
codes.hint: Ask your admin to give it back.

codes.title: Login key taken
codes.shopkeeper: That login key is already taken, even by someone who was removed.
codes.hint: Pick a different key.

codes.title: Platform approval is off
codes.shopkeeper: Platform approval is not switched on here.
codes.hint: Ask the platform operator to set the admin key.

codes.title: Platform key not accepted
codes.shopkeeper: That platform key is not accepted.
codes.hint: Check the key and try again.

codes.title: Advice already recorded
codes.shopkeeper: An advice is already recorded for this payment.
codes.hint: Open the payment to see it.

codes.title: AI not available
codes.shopkeeper: AI drafting is not available for your shop right now.
codes.hint: Check your AI allowance in Settings.

codes.title: AI limit reached
codes.shopkeeper: You have used your AI allowance for now.
codes.hint: Try again later.

codes.title: AI did not answer
codes.shopkeeper: The AI did not answer just now.
codes.hint: Try again in a moment.

codes.title: AI not connected
codes.shopkeeper: The AI is not available just now.
codes.hint: Try again later, or raise the request by hand.

codes.title: All refused
codes.shopkeeper: Every send was refused, so nothing went out.
codes.hint: Open Offers sent to see why.

codes.title: All sent
codes.shopkeeper: Not an error. Everything on this counter has been sent.
codes.hint: Nothing to do.

codes.title: Already assigned
codes.shopkeeper: Someone already holds this task.
codes.hint: Ask them to hand it back first.

codes.title: Already claimed
codes.shopkeeper: This business has already been claimed.
codes.hint: Sign in with its claim code, or ask the network for a new one.

codes.title: Already paid
codes.shopkeeper: This looks like a payment you already recorded.
codes.hint: Check the list, then confirm if it is really a new one.

codes.title: Already recorded
codes.shopkeeper: That is already recorded.
codes.hint: Refresh the list: it is already there.

codes.title: Already reversed
codes.shopkeeper: This entry was already reversed.
codes.hint: Open the reversal to see it.

codes.title: Ambiguous name
codes.shopkeeper: More than one business has that name.
codes.hint: Ask your admin for the exact login.

codes.title: Already answered
codes.shopkeeper: Not found, or already answered: an answer is given once.
codes.hint: Refresh the list.

codes.title: Question not usable
codes.shopkeeper: That question could not be used.
codes.hint: Read the sentence shown, fix it and try again.

codes.title: Assistant resting
codes.shopkeeper: The assistant is resting for now.
codes.hint: The help library answers instead; try again later.

codes.title: Assistant not switched on
codes.shopkeeper: The assistant is not switched on here yet.
codes.hint: The help library answers instead.

codes.title: Help desks only
codes.shopkeeper: Only a help desk can publish to its catalogue.
codes.hint: Ask your help desk to publish this answer.

codes.title: Owned by another brand
codes.shopkeeper: That belongs to another brand, so you cannot change it.
codes.hint: Change only what your own business owns.

codes.title: No answer this time
codes.shopkeeper: The assistant did not produce an answer.
codes.hint: Try again, or read the help library.

codes.title: Review has moved
codes.shopkeeper: Reviewing questions here is retired.
codes.hint: Answer the question on its chit, then publish it.

codes.title: Sign in for the assistant
codes.shopkeeper: Sign in for fuller answers from the assistant.
codes.hint: Sign in and ask again; the help library answers meanwhile.

codes.title: Assistant busy
codes.shopkeeper: The assistant is busy right now.
codes.hint: Try again in a moment.

codes.title: File is empty
codes.shopkeeper: That file has nothing in it.
codes.hint: Choose a file that is not empty.

codes.title: File details missing
codes.shopkeeper: The chit, the file's name or the file itself was left out.
codes.hint: Choose the chit and the file again, then send.

codes.title: Not on this chit
codes.shopkeeper: You are not on this chit, so you cannot put a file on it.
codes.hint: Open a chit you are part of and try again.

codes.title: Auto token
codes.shopkeeper: This sign-in is no longer valid.
codes.hint: Sign in again.

codes.title: Rule would be loosened
codes.shopkeeper: That would loosen a rule the platform has set.
codes.hint: Only tighten the setting, never loosen it.

codes.title: Bad day word
codes.shopkeeper: Pick one of the days offered.
codes.hint: Choose a day from the list.

codes.title: Not on your team
codes.shopkeeper: That person is not on your team.
codes.hint: Pick someone from your team.

codes.title: Bad time
codes.shopkeeper: Give the time as a date.
codes.hint: Pick a date and try again.

codes.title: Bad channel
codes.shopkeeper: Channel is phone, sms, whatsapp, email or chitbridge.
codes.hint: Pick one of those.

codes.title: Bad due day
codes.shopkeeper: Pick a day from today.
codes.hint: Choose today or a later day.

codes.title: Flag not true or false
codes.shopkeeper: priceIncludesTax must be true or false.
codes.hint: Send true or false.

codes.title: Not a stage
codes.shopkeeper: That is not one of the stages.
codes.hint: Pick a stage from the list.

codes.title: Not a valid id
codes.shopkeeper: That is not a valid id.
codes.hint: Open it again from the list.

codes.title: Not a segment
codes.shopkeeper: That is not a segment or a group.
codes.hint: Pick one from the list.

codes.title: Unknown grouping
codes.shopkeeper: That grouping is not known.
codes.hint: Use the buttons on the screen.

codes.title: Bad name
codes.shopkeeper: Give a name. A group name is up to 40 letters, digits, spaces, - & /.
codes.hint: Check the name and try again.

codes.title: Bad outcome
codes.shopkeeper: Pick what happened on the call.
codes.hint: Tap one of the outcome buttons.

codes.title: Bad period
codes.shopkeeper: Ask for a week, a month, a quarter or a year.
codes.hint: Pick one of those and try again.

codes.title: Bad phone
codes.shopkeeper: Type the mobile number with its country code, 10 to 15 digits.
codes.hint: Check the number and try again.

codes.title: Price below zero
codes.shopkeeper: A line has a price below 0.
codes.hint: Send a price of 0 or more.

codes.title: Bad purpose
codes.shopkeeper: Purpose is service or marketing.
codes.hint: Pick one of those.

codes.title: Quantity not above zero
codes.shopkeeper: A line needs a quantity above 0.
codes.hint: Send a quantity above 0 on every line.

codes.title: Tax rate out of range
codes.shopkeeper: A line has a tax rate outside 0 to 100 percent.
codes.hint: Send a rate from 0 to 100.

codes.title: Not in that state
codes.shopkeeper: This connection is not in a state where that can be done.
codes.hint: Refresh the list and look at where it stands.

codes.title: Unknown connection type
codes.shopkeeper: A connection is either governance or commercial.
codes.hint: Send one of those two words.

codes.title: Bill not recorded
codes.shopkeeper: That bill has not reached ChitBridge yet.
codes.hint: It is tried again once the bill arrives.

codes.title: Too large
codes.shopkeeper: What you sent is too big to accept.
codes.hint: Send less at a time.

codes.title: Ledger needs an answer
codes.shopkeeper: The ledger needs one more answer before it can do that.
codes.hint: Read the question shown and answer it.

codes.title: Ledger cannot take that
codes.shopkeeper: The ledger cannot take that as it stands.
codes.hint: Read the sentence shown, fix it and try again.

codes.title: Ledger calculations unavailable
codes.shopkeeper: The ledger calculations are not available yet.
codes.hint: Try again later. If it stays, tell us.

codes.title: Ledger update pending
codes.shopkeeper: This cannot be saved yet: a database update is still to arrive.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Ledger refused
codes.shopkeeper: The ledger refused that, and the sentence says why.
codes.hint: Fix what the sentence says and try again.

codes.title: Buyer tax number not accepted
codes.shopkeeper: The buyer's tax number on this bill does not check out for your country.
codes.hint: Check the buyer's number and send the bill again.

codes.title: More than the plan allows
codes.shopkeeper: That is more than this shop's plan allows.
codes.hint: Choose from what the plan grants.

codes.title: Capability off
codes.shopkeeper: This shop has switched its connector capability off, so devices and connectors are refused.
codes.hint: Turn the connector capability back on to resume.

codes.title: Message not handled
codes.shopkeeper: That message could not be handled as asked.
codes.hint: Read the line shown, then try again.

codes.title: Inbox not ready
codes.shopkeeper: The inbox is not set up on this system yet.
codes.hint: Ask your administrator to finish the update.

codes.title: Shop already has products
codes.shopkeeper: This shop already has products.
codes.hint: Start a starter list only on an empty shop.

codes.title: Saved catalogues not ready
codes.shopkeeper: Saved catalogues are not ready on this server yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Categories not set up
codes.shopkeeper: Your categories could not be set up, so nothing was added.
codes.hint: Try again in a moment.

codes.title: Address already in use
codes.shopkeeper: That number or address is already in use.
codes.hint: Use another one, or ask the platform if it is yours.

codes.title: Channel details not valid
codes.shopkeeper: Something in the channel details is missing or not one we know.
codes.hint: Check the details and try again.

codes.title: Channel not sendable
codes.shopkeeper: Only WhatsApp can be sent from here today.
codes.hint: Use WhatsApp.

codes.title: Only the platform can approve
codes.shopkeeper: Only the platform can mark a template approved.
codes.hint: Mark it as waiting; the platform will approve it.

codes.title: Channel request refused
codes.shopkeeper: The channel request was refused.
codes.hint: Check the details and try again.

codes.title: Channels not ready
codes.shopkeeper: Channels are not ready on this system yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Business not found
codes.shopkeeper: We could not find that business.
codes.hint: Check its handle and try again.

codes.title: Task and action needed
codes.shopkeeper: Say which task and what to do with it.
codes.hint: Send the task and the action.

codes.title: Chit request not accepted
codes.shopkeeper: That chit request could not be done.
codes.hint: Read the message, fix what it names and try again.

codes.title: Cannot withdraw
codes.shopkeeper: This chit cannot be withdrawn from where it is.
codes.hint: Raise a dispute on it if something is wrong.

codes.title: Chit not in that state
codes.shopkeeper: The chit is not in a state that allows that.
codes.hint: Look at the chit again, then try once more.

codes.title: Chit details not valid
codes.shopkeeper: Something on the chit is missing or not valid.
codes.hint: Read the list of fields it names, fix them and try again.

codes.title: Not a bill
codes.shopkeeper: Only a bill you received says what its goods are for.
codes.hint: Open a bill you received.

codes.title: Chit not delivered
codes.shopkeeper: The reading arrived but its chit could not be delivered.
codes.hint: The device keeps the event and sends it again.

codes.title: Chits update still to run
codes.shopkeeper: This part of chits is not ready on this server yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Not allowed on this chit
codes.shopkeeper: This login is not allowed to do that on this chit.
codes.hint: Ask the owner for the right access, or open the chit from the side that holds it.

codes.title: Shop has no ChitBridge address
codes.shopkeeper: This shop has no ChitBridge address yet, so this cannot be recorded.
codes.hint: Open Settings, set the shop address, then send the bill again.

codes.title: Customer priority already set
codes.shopkeeper: The customer priority on this chit is set once and cannot change.
codes.hint: Leave it as it is.

codes.title: A reason is needed
codes.shopkeeper: An urgent priority needs a reason.
codes.hint: Write the reason and try again.

codes.title: Too many at once
codes.shopkeeper: That is more than can be done in one go.
codes.hint: Send fewer, then repeat for the rest.

codes.title: Chit refused
codes.shopkeeper: That was understood but cannot be done as it stands.
codes.hint: Read the sentence shown and fix what it names.

codes.title: Value not accepted
codes.shopkeeper: The database does not accept one of those values yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Choose identity
codes.shopkeeper: That contact is on more than one account.
codes.hint: Choose the account you want.

codes.title: Claim recorded
codes.shopkeeper: That claim is already recorded.
codes.hint: Nothing more to do: the points were moved.

codes.title: Too many codes
codes.shopkeeper: Five codes were made for this person in the last 15 minutes.
codes.hint: Wait a few minutes, then make a new one.

codes.title: No code asked for
codes.shopkeeper: Ask for a code first — none was sent to that phone or email at this shop.
codes.hint: Tap "Send code", then type the code you get.

codes.title: Showing a code is not ready
codes.shopkeeper: This environment cannot show a first code yet, so none was made.
codes.hint: Add their e-mail, or try again later.

codes.title: Combo needs groups
codes.shopkeeper: A combo needs at least one group, each with a name and options.
codes.hint: Add a group with an option and save again.

codes.title: Combo needs a name
codes.shopkeeper: A saved combo needs a name of up to 120 characters.
codes.hint: Type a name you will look for later.

codes.title: Combo price not valid
codes.shopkeeper: The price must be a number and cannot be negative.
codes.hint: Type a price of 0 or more, or leave it empty.

codes.title: Combo price needed
codes.shopkeeper: Give this combo a price before pushing it as a new product.
codes.hint: Set the price, then push again.

codes.title: Combo refused
codes.shopkeeper: This combo cannot be saved as it stands.
codes.hint: Read the sentence shown and fix it.

codes.title: Comment only
codes.shopkeeper: Your access is comment-only.
codes.hint: Ask the owner for edit access.

codes.title: Compare not allowed
codes.shopkeeper: Only the owner or the shop's auditor may compare the books.
codes.hint: Ask the owner.

codes.title: Confirm remove
codes.shopkeeper: Removing a person cannot be undone, so it needs your confirmation.
codes.hint: Confirm the removal to go on.

codes.title: Rule not met
codes.shopkeeper: That does not meet the platform's rules.
codes.hint: Change it to fit the rules, then try again.

codes.title: Cannot connect to yourself
codes.shopkeeper: You cannot connect to your own business.
codes.hint: Choose another business.

codes.title: Already connected
codes.shopkeeper: A connection with this business already exists.
codes.hint: Open your connections to see where it stands.

codes.title: Connection switched off
codes.shopkeeper: This device connection is switched off.
codes.hint: Switch it on in the connector’s list.

codes.title: Connector has devices
codes.shopkeeper: This connector still has devices attached.
codes.hint: Remove its devices first, then delete it.

codes.title: Connector has no key
codes.shopkeeper: This connector was set up without a key, so there is nothing to approve.
codes.hint: Download the kit again while signed in as the owner.

codes.title: Connector in use
codes.shopkeeper: This connector has raised records, so it cannot be deleted.
codes.hint: Switch its devices off instead.

codes.title: Key reissue not allowed
codes.shopkeeper: Only the business admin or a manager can reissue a device key.
codes.hint: Ask the admin or a manager to do it.

codes.title: Gateway name does not match
codes.shopkeeper: The gateway name you typed does not match.
codes.hint: Type the name exactly as it is shown.

codes.title: Connector not approved
codes.shopkeeper: This connector is waiting for approval.
codes.hint: Approve this PC in Settings, Integrations, Running connectors.

codes.title: No email to send to
codes.shopkeeper: The business has no email address to send the code to.
codes.hint: Add an email address in Settings, then ask again.

codes.title: Wrong kind of connector
codes.shopkeeper: This door is only for ERP connectors.
codes.hint: Devices send their readings to the device door.

codes.title: Consent unreadable
codes.shopkeeper: We could not read their consent, so nothing was sent.
codes.hint: Try again in a moment.

codes.title: Consent withdrawn
codes.shopkeeper: They took back their consent.
codes.hint: Do not message them on this channel.

codes.title: Phone or email not usable
codes.shopkeeper: Enter one phone number or one email — not both, and in a form we can send to.
codes.hint: Check the number or the address and try again.

codes.title: Product containers not ready
codes.shopkeeper: Product containers are not ready on this server yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Cost blind
codes.shopkeeper: Your access does not include cost or price.
codes.hint: Ask the owner to give you Sees costs, or change availability only.

codes.title: Counter request not valid
codes.shopkeeper: That counter request is missing something or is not right.
codes.hint: Check the name and try again.

codes.title: Counter closed
codes.shopkeeper: This counter was closed or taken by another device, so it cannot bill.
codes.hint: Sign in here to take it back, or open a new counter.

codes.title: Counter held
codes.shopkeeper: That counter is open on another PC.
codes.hint: Close it there first, or take it over when asked.

codes.title: Counter update pending
codes.shopkeeper: Counters cannot be changed yet: a database update is still to arrive.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Counters need a person
codes.shopkeeper: Counters are managed by a signed-in person, not by a key.
codes.hint: Sign in as the owner to change a counter.

codes.title: Country setup not ready
codes.shopkeeper: Country setup arrives after the next update. Selling and the rail work meanwhile.
codes.hint: Carry on selling; come back after the update.

codes.title: Country setup pending
codes.shopkeeper: Finish the country setup before using the ledger.
codes.hint: Open Country setup and complete it.

codes.title: Cover conflict
codes.shopkeeper: Going off would leave someone without cover.
codes.hint: Wait until the other person is back, or change who covers.

codes.title: Bad request
codes.shopkeeper: What was sent is not in the form CRM expects.
codes.hint: Send the fields as one JSON object, each once.

codes.title: Crm not migrated
codes.shopkeeper: Follow-ups and call notes are not set up here yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Chit id already here
codes.shopkeeper: A chit with this id is already here, from a different sender.
codes.hint: Chit ids are minted once; the sender should mint a new id, not reuse one.

codes.title: Crossing refused
codes.shopkeeper: This business does not take chits from that installation.
codes.hint: The two installations must name each other as peers first.

codes.title: Crossing cannot be checked
codes.shopkeeper: We could not check whether this chit may cross, so we refused it.
codes.hint: Try again later; nothing was written.

codes.title: Draft stays here
codes.shopkeeper: A draft is not sent anywhere, and some of its copies belong to another installation.
codes.hint: Send it for real, or keep only this installation's copies.

codes.title: Envelope refused
codes.shopkeeper: The chit did not open here: its signature or its contents were refused.
codes.hint: Check the sending installation signs with the key it publishes.

codes.title: Manifest unavailable
codes.shopkeeper: This installation could not say who it is just now.
codes.hint: Try again later.

codes.title: Not a CTP envelope
codes.shopkeeper: This is not a chit this door understands.
codes.hint: Send a CTP/1 envelope.

codes.title: Not a CTP query
codes.shopkeeper: This is not a question this door understands.
codes.hint: Send a CTP/1 query.

codes.title: No installation named
codes.shopkeeper: The message does not say which installation sent it.
codes.hint: Send it from an installation that names itself.

codes.title: No recipient named
codes.shopkeeper: The chit does not say which business it is for.
codes.hint: Name the recipient by its bridge id.

codes.title: No sender named
codes.shopkeeper: The chit does not say which business sent it.
codes.hint: The sending installation must name its sender.

codes.title: Installation is hosted here
codes.shopkeeper: That installation lives on this server, so its chits must not come over the internet.
codes.hint: Deliver it locally.

codes.title: Peer's key cannot be read
codes.shopkeeper: We could not read the other installation's public key, so we cannot trust the message.
codes.hint: Check the other installation's manifest is reachable.

codes.title: Installation not known
codes.shopkeeper: We do not deal with that installation.
codes.hint: The owners of both installations must agree to connect first.

codes.title: Question failed
codes.shopkeeper: This installation could not answer just now.
codes.hint: Try again later.

codes.title: Question refused
codes.shopkeeper: The question was not signed by the installation that sent it.
codes.hint: Check the asking installation signs with the key it publishes.

codes.title: Recipient not here
codes.shopkeeper: There is no active business here with that bridge id.
codes.hint: Check the address of the business.

codes.title: Not delivered
codes.shopkeeper: Another installation did not take its copy of this chit. Nothing was written.
codes.hint: Try again later. If it keeps happening, check the two installations name each other as peers.

codes.title: Sender not named by an id
codes.shopkeeper: The chit names the business that sent it by something that is not an id.
codes.hint: The sending installation must name its sender by id.

codes.title: Sender not theirs to name
codes.shopkeeper: The chit names a sender that does not belong to the installation that signed it.
codes.hint: The sending installation may only send for its own businesses.

codes.title: Sender cannot be checked
codes.shopkeeper: We could not check whose business the sender is, so we did not take the chit.
codes.hint: Try again later.

codes.title: Could not store the chit
codes.shopkeeper: This installation could not store the chit just now.
codes.hint: Try again later; it was not written.

codes.title: Unknown question
codes.shopkeeper: This installation does not answer that question.
codes.hint: Ask to resolve a business or for its catalogue.

codes.title: Currency is the business’s
codes.shopkeeper: The currency your prices are written in belongs to the business.
codes.hint: Ask whoever runs the account to change it in Settings.

codes.title: Not a currency code
codes.shopkeeper: That is not a currency code.
codes.hint: Use the three-letter code, like SGD.

codes.title: Currency not available
codes.shopkeeper: That currency is not available for this business.
codes.hint: Choose one of the currencies listed.

codes.title: Wrong money for this ledger
codes.shopkeeper: This payment is in a different money from the ledger's.
codes.hint: Use the ledger's own money.

codes.title: Would loop
codes.shopkeeper: A network cannot sit under one of its own members.
codes.hint: Choose a different network to join.

codes.title: Definitions not set up
codes.shopkeeper: Your saved offers, slabs and models are not set up here yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Slab still in use
codes.shopkeeper: Products or categories still use this slab.
codes.hint: Choose the slab that takes over, then retire this one.

codes.title: Set by the country
codes.shopkeeper: This slab is set by your country and cannot be changed here.
codes.hint: To differ from it, add a slab of your own.

codes.title: Rule has no value
codes.shopkeeper: This rule has no value yet, so it would do nothing.
codes.hint: Fill in the value, then save again.

codes.title: Name already used
codes.shopkeeper: You already have one of this kind with that name.
codes.hint: Choose another name.

codes.title: Slab cannot take over
codes.shopkeeper: The slab chosen to take over is not a live slab here.
codes.hint: Choose one of your live slabs.

codes.title: Same slab chosen
codes.shopkeeper: The slab chosen to take over is the one being retired.
codes.hint: Choose a different slab.

codes.title: Device mismatch
codes.shopkeeper: This sign-in belongs to another device.
codes.hint: Sign in again on this device.

codes.title: Device revoked
codes.shopkeeper: The owner removed this device.
codes.hint: Ask the owner to add it again.

codes.title: Device may not send there
codes.shopkeeper: A device can send only to its own shop and the shop’s own customers or suppliers.
codes.hint: Send to one of those, or leave the recipient out.

codes.title: Disputes not set up yet
codes.shopkeeper: Disputes are not switched on on this server yet, so there are none to show.
codes.hint: Nothing to do; they will appear once the update has run.

codes.title: Disputes not set up
codes.shopkeeper: Disputes are not set up on this server yet.
codes.hint: Tell us; the update has to be run.

codes.title: Dispute already resolved
codes.shopkeeper: That dispute is already resolved.
codes.hint: Nothing more to do.

codes.title: Dispute already open
codes.shopkeeper: You already have an open dispute of that kind on this chit.
codes.hint: Open the existing dispute instead.

codes.title: Not a party to the dispute
codes.shopkeeper: That business is not a party to this dispute.
codes.hint: Pick one of the parties listed on the dispute.

codes.title: Dsp
codes.shopkeeper: Not an error. DSP stands for the Disputes folder.
codes.hint: Nothing to do.

codes.title: Duplicate party
codes.shopkeeper: Another party on your list already has this tax number.
codes.hint: Check the number, or open the party that holds it.

codes.title: Connection not found
codes.shopkeeper: We could not find that connection.
codes.hint: Refresh the list; it may have been removed.

codes.title: Email delivery not configured
codes.shopkeeper: This shop cannot e-mail a first code yet, so nothing was changed.
codes.hint: Set up e-mail sending first.

codes.title: Email taken
codes.shopkeeper: That e-mail already signs in to another account.
codes.hint: Use the person's own e-mail, or leave it empty.

codes.title: Employee email required
codes.shopkeeper: This person needs an e-mail address for the first code.
codes.hint: Add their e-mail, then try again.

codes.title: Request not usable
codes.shopkeeper: What was sent is missing something or cannot be used.
codes.hint: Read the sentence shown, fix it and try again.

codes.title: Clashes with what is recorded
codes.shopkeeper: That clashes with what is already recorded.
codes.hint: Read the sentence shown, then pick another.

codes.title: Email already used
codes.shopkeeper: A shop with that email already exists.
codes.hint: Use another email.

codes.title: Update still to run
codes.shopkeeper: This part is not ready on this server yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Shop limit reached
codes.shopkeeper: This installation cannot add another shop on its plan.
codes.hint: Choose a plan with room for more shops.

codes.title: Protected business
codes.shopkeeper: This business is protected and cannot be erased.
codes.hint: Nothing to do: protected businesses stay.

codes.title: Something went wrong
codes.shopkeeper: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
codes.hint: If it keeps happening, tell us the request id.

codes.title: Not signed in to live updates
codes.shopkeeper: Sign in to get live updates.
codes.hint: Sign in, then try again.

codes.title: Live updates link expired
codes.shopkeeper: The live-updates link has run out. Reload the page to connect again.
codes.hint: Reload the page.

codes.title: Already asked or connected
codes.shopkeeper: You have already asked, or are already connected.
codes.hint: Open the connection to see where it stands.

codes.title: Folder request not accepted
codes.shopkeeper: That folder request could not be done.
codes.hint: Read the message, fix what it names and try again.

codes.title: Folder details not valid
codes.shopkeeper: The folder name or id is missing or not valid.
codes.hint: Give the folder a name of 1 to 60 characters, then try again.

codes.title: Not a place for chits
codes.shopkeeper: That folder shows what its rule matches, so nothing can be moved into it.
codes.hint: Move the chit to a filing folder instead.

codes.title: Folders update still to run
codes.shopkeeper: This part of folders is not ready on this server yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Folder on the other track
codes.shopkeeper: A Task folder holds chits that came to you; an Order folder holds chits you sent.
codes.hint: Pick a folder on the chit's own track.

codes.title: Form already signed
codes.shopkeeper: This form is already signed.
codes.hint: Open it to see who signed it.

codes.title: Not a deal
codes.shopkeeper: That is not a deal.
codes.hint: Pick the deal from the list.

codes.title: Form not done
codes.shopkeeper: The form could not be filled in or signed as asked.
codes.hint: Check what is missing, then try again.

codes.title: Form not found
codes.shopkeeper: We could not find that form.
codes.hint: Go back to the list of forms and pick again.

codes.title: Not on this chit
codes.shopkeeper: Your shop is not on that chit, so the form cannot be filed there.
codes.hint: Pick a chit your shop is on.

codes.title: Form refused
codes.shopkeeper: The form could not be done.
codes.hint: Try again, or ask the person who set it up.

codes.title: Forms not set up
codes.shopkeeper: Forms are not available here yet.
codes.hint: Ask the platform operator to set them up.

codes.title: Form not ready
codes.shopkeeper: The form is missing some details it needs.
codes.hint: Fill in the fields listed, then try again.

codes.title: Exchange rate missing
codes.shopkeeper: There is no exchange rate for that day.
codes.hint: Add the rate for that day, then try again.

codes.title: Fx rate of day
codes.shopkeeper: Not an error. This note shows the exchange rate used for that day.
codes.hint: Nothing to do.

codes.title: Needs one more answer
codes.shopkeeper: Something needed is missing.
codes.hint: Read the question shown and answer it.

codes.title: Clashes with what is recorded
codes.shopkeeper: That clashes with what is already recorded.
codes.hint: Reload the page and try again.

codes.title: Not available yet
codes.shopkeeper: That is not available on this installation yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Could not be done as sent
codes.shopkeeper: That could not be done as it was sent.
codes.hint: Check what was sent and try again.

codes.title: Groups not set up
codes.shopkeeper: Named groups are not set up here yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: ERP handoffs not ready
codes.shopkeeper: ERP handoffs are not ready on this server yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Open dues
codes.shopkeeper: There are open dues on this party.
codes.hint: Settle the dues first, then remove them.

codes.title: Already in a network
codes.shopkeeper: That business is already in a network, and a business can be in one at a time.
codes.hint: Remove it from that network first.

codes.title: Idempotency conflict
codes.shopkeeper: This was already sent once, with different details.
codes.hint: Start it again; the new try goes as its own.

codes.title: Idempotency in progress
codes.shopkeeper: The same request is still being handled.
codes.hint: Wait a moment and look before sending it again.

codes.title: Idempotency key required
codes.shopkeeper: The order came without its one-time mark, so nothing was sent.
codes.hint: Reload the shop page and try again.

codes.title: Idoc consent required
codes.shopkeeper: Someone else's Aadhaar can be recorded only with their agreement.
codes.hint: Confirm they agreed, or ask them to enter it from their own profile.

codes.title: Idoc employer only
codes.shopkeeper: Your employer records this document after checking it against the original.
codes.hint: Add your mobile and e-mail here; a code confirms them.

codes.title: Document number not valid
codes.shopkeeper: That does not look like the document you chose.
codes.hint: Check the number and try again.

codes.title: Idoc not code verified
codes.shopkeeper: Only a mobile number or an e-mail is confirmed by a code.
codes.hint: Your employer checks the other documents.

codes.title: Idoc not found
codes.shopkeeper: That document is not on file yet.
codes.hint: Add it first, then ask for a code.

codes.title: Idoc not migrated
codes.shopkeeper: Identity records are not switched on yet.
codes.hint: Try again later.

codes.title: Idoc no code
codes.shopkeeper: No code has been asked for yet.
codes.hint: Ask for a code first.

codes.title: Document request refused
codes.shopkeeper: That could not be done.
codes.hint: Read the message shown: it says why.

codes.title: Not your co-assist
codes.shopkeeper: That person is not one of your co-assists.
codes.hint: Only the account owner can record a document for their own co-assists.

codes.title: Document not recognised
codes.shopkeeper: That document is not offered for your country.
codes.hint: Pick one from the list.

codes.title: Idoc value unavailable
codes.shopkeeper: The saved number or e-mail cannot be read.
codes.hint: Enter it again, then ask for a code.

codes.title: Inr
codes.shopkeeper: Not an error. INR stands for the rupee.
codes.hint: Nothing to do.

codes.title: Request not usable
codes.shopkeeper: Something this needs is missing or not valid.
codes.hint: Check the order or the fields named, then send it again.

codes.title: Something went wrong
codes.shopkeeper: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
codes.hint: If it keeps happening, tell us the request id.

codes.title: Action not understood
codes.shopkeeper: That is not something this can do.
codes.hint: Send pool, or push with a colleague.

codes.title: Default person not allowed
codes.shopkeeper: The default person must be able to take tasks.
codes.hint: Pick a person with Act or Manager access.

codes.title: Odd character
codes.shopkeeper: What was sent holds a character that cannot be saved. It often comes from pasting out of a PDF or from a scanner.
codes.hint: Remove the odd character, or type that part again.

codes.title: Cover not allowed
codes.shopkeeper: That person cannot cover.
codes.hint: Pick someone else who can take tasks.

codes.title: Input not valid
codes.shopkeeper: Some of what was sent is missing or not valid.
codes.hint: Fix the fields listed and send it again.

codes.title: Request not readable
codes.shopkeeper: What was sent could not be read. It is cut off or is not a proper set of details.
codes.hint: Check it is complete, then send it again.

codes.title: Key request not valid
codes.shopkeeper: That key cannot be made as asked.
codes.hint: Pick a listed kind, and revoke a key if you have twenty.

codes.title: Invoice needs lines
codes.shopkeeper: The invoice needs at least one line.
codes.hint: Send the lines to invoice.

codes.title: Bill is not a tax invoice yet
codes.shopkeeper: The sale is saved as a bill, not a tax invoice: over the limit the buyer must be named.
codes.hint: Name the buyer or add their tax number to issue the tax invoice.

codes.title: Open chit on the connection
codes.shopkeeper: A chit is still open on this connection.
codes.hint: Settle it first, or disconnect and settle together.

codes.title: In use
codes.shopkeeper: Products still hold a value in this column.
codes.hint: Clear it on those products first, or keep the column.

codes.title: Already a customer
codes.shopkeeper: They are a customer now, so there is no lead stage to move.
codes.hint: Nothing to do.

codes.title: Item not on the shelf
codes.shopkeeper: A line names an item this shop does not sell.
codes.hint: Check the item id or code.

codes.title: A key cannot decide this
codes.shopkeeper: A connector cannot decide this on its own. Sign in as a person.
codes.hint: Sign in to the shop and do it there.

codes.title: A key cannot manage keys
codes.shopkeeper: A key cannot make or remove keys. Sign in as a person.
codes.hint: Sign in to the shop and do it there.

codes.title: A key cannot see Home
codes.shopkeeper: Sign in to see the Home figures.
codes.hint: Open the app with your login, not a key.

codes.title: Key cannot sign in
codes.shopkeeper: A counter key cannot be used to sign in.
codes.hint: Sign in with your own login.

codes.title: Key not found
codes.shopkeeper: There is no key with that id in this shop.
codes.hint: Refresh the list of keys.

codes.title: Key not scoped
codes.shopkeeper: This key is not allowed to do that.
codes.hint: Use a key made for this, or sign in as a person.

codes.title: Key revoked
codes.shopkeeper: This key was removed or is not known.
codes.hint: Make a new key and use that.

codes.title: Key not recognised
codes.shopkeeper: This key is not recognised, or its connector is inactive.
codes.hint: Check the key, or issue a new one from the connector.

codes.title: Nothing to add
codes.shopkeeper: Say what the paper is called, or give its standard, and try again.
codes.hint: Type the name of the paper (for example Village NOC) and add it.

codes.title: Refused
codes.shopkeeper: The Know your business page could not do that as asked.
codes.hint: Read the line shown, change what you sent and try again.

codes.title: Lab chit on a live shop
codes.shopkeeper: A practice chit cannot be sent from a live shop.
codes.hint: Send it from a practice shop, or make a real chit.

codes.title: Leads not migrated
codes.shopkeeper: Lead stages are not set up here yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Ledger switched off
codes.shopkeeper: This shop has not switched the ledger on.
codes.hint: The owner can switch it on.

codes.title: Lines needed
codes.shopkeeper: Send at least one line with a quantity and a unit price.
codes.hint: Add the lines to evaluate and send again.

codes.title: Below what was delivered
codes.shopkeeper: That would take the line below what has been delivered.
codes.hint: Record a negative delivery first.

codes.title: Line already delivered
codes.shopkeeper: That line has been delivered, so it cannot be changed this way.
codes.hint: Record a negative delivery to take it back.

codes.title: Unit locked
codes.shopkeeper: The unit cannot change once something has been delivered.
codes.hint: Leave the unit as it is.

codes.title: Locked
codes.shopkeeper: This column is one every catalogue keeps, so it cannot be changed that way.
codes.hint: Leave it as it is.

codes.title: Max tasks over entity
codes.shopkeeper: That is more tasks than the shop allows one person.
codes.hint: Raise the limit in Settings first, or give fewer.

codes.title: Membership suspended
codes.shopkeeper: The network has suspended your membership, so you cannot send to it.
codes.hint: Ask the network to resume it, then send again.

codes.title: Not switched on yet
codes.shopkeeper: Unit and source are not switched on for your account yet.
codes.hint: Type, label and required still work; try again after the next update.

codes.title: Could not make an id
codes.shopkeeper: We could not make an id for this business just now.
codes.hint: Try again in a moment.

codes.title: Could not add
codes.shopkeeper: They could not be added.
codes.hint: Check the name and phone and try again.

codes.title: Field missing
codes.shopkeeper: A needed field was left out.
codes.hint: Fill in the field named and send it again.

codes.title: Who came back update pending
codes.shopkeeper: Who came back arrives after the next update.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Messaging level too high
codes.shopkeeper: That folder can be kept internal or switched off, but not shared further than its default.
codes.hint: Pick a lower level.

codes.title: Messaging level fixed
codes.shopkeeper: This folder's messaging level cannot be changed.
codes.hint: Leave it as it is.

codes.title: Name needed
codes.shopkeeper: A business needs a name.
codes.hint: Send a name.

codes.title: Name the person
codes.shopkeeper: Say who is away.
codes.hint: Pick the person.

codes.title: Day needed
codes.shopkeeper: Say when to follow up.
codes.hint: Pick a day.

codes.title: Network request not usable
codes.shopkeeper: What was sent to the network is missing something or cannot be used.
codes.hint: Read the sentence, fix it and try again.

codes.title: Network name taken
codes.shopkeeper: One of these names was taken while the network was being built. Nothing was created.
codes.hint: Try again.

codes.title: Stores already up to date
codes.shopkeeper: Your stores already have every change.
codes.hint: Nothing to publish.

codes.title: Nothing waiting
codes.shopkeeper: Nothing is waiting to be published.
codes.hint: Publish a change first.

codes.title: Catalogue not sold here
codes.shopkeeper: This store does not sell that catalogue.
codes.hint: Join the network catalogue first.

codes.title: Network orders off
codes.shopkeeper: Ordering across this network is not switched on here.
codes.hint: Order from the shop itself instead.

codes.title: Owner only
codes.shopkeeper: Only the business owner can do this.
codes.hint: Sign in as the business itself.

codes.title: No brand price
codes.shopkeeper: The brand has no price for that product.
codes.hint: Ask the brand to suggest a price.

codes.title: Network not read
codes.shopkeeper: We could not read who is in the network just now. Nothing was changed.
codes.hint: Try again in a minute.

codes.title: Network step refused
codes.shopkeeper: The network cannot take that step as it stands.
codes.hint: Read the sentence shown and fix it.

codes.title: Network request not valid
codes.shopkeeper: That request is not valid: the sentence says what to change.
codes.hint: Fix what the sentence says and send again.

codes.title: Drawing too large
codes.shopkeeper: The drawing is too big to save.
codes.hint: Take some of it out and save again.

codes.title: Network editing is off
codes.shopkeeper: Network changes aren't available yet.
codes.hint: Try again later.

codes.title: Nothing to do
codes.shopkeeper: Say who to add or remove.
codes.hint: Pick at least one customer.

codes.title: Nothing to update
codes.shopkeeper: Nothing was sent to change.
codes.hint: Fill in at least one field.

codes.title: Activity clearing update pending
codes.shopkeeper: Activity cannot be cleared yet: a database update is still to arrive.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Nothing to clear
codes.shopkeeper: There is nothing chosen to clear.
codes.hint: Pick an item to clear, or choose clear all.

codes.title: Unread count update pending
codes.shopkeeper: The unread count cannot be cleared yet: a database update is still to arrive.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Not allowed
codes.shopkeeper: Only the two businesses on a connection, or the network above it, can do that.
codes.hint: Ask the other business or the network.

codes.title: Not the assignee
codes.shopkeeper: Only the owner or the assignee can hand this on.
codes.hint: Ask the owner or the person it is assigned to.

codes.title: Not board reader
codes.shopkeeper: The test board is for builders.
codes.hint: Use your own incidents and requirements, or ask a builder.

codes.title: Not board writer
codes.shopkeeper: Only the board’s own account can change the shared cases and records.
codes.hint: Ask the board’s owner, or record your result instead.

codes.title: Not for your country
codes.shopkeeper: This is not offered for a shop in your country.
codes.hint: The message names what to use instead.

codes.title: Not found
codes.shopkeeper: We could not find that.
codes.hint: Check the address or the name and try again.

codes.title: Not paired
codes.shopkeeper: This counter is not linked to a shop yet, so the shop turns everything away.
codes.hint: Sign in on the counter to link it.

codes.title: Platform only
codes.shopkeeper: That kind of key is made by the platform, not by a shop.
codes.hint: Pick one of the kinds listed.

codes.title: Platform operator only
codes.shopkeeper: This is for the platform operator only.
codes.hint: Ask the platform operator.

codes.title: Not this network
codes.shopkeeper: You are signed in at a store outside this network.
codes.hint: Sign in at this network's store to order.

codes.title: Not written
codes.shopkeeper: A sign-in note could not be saved. Your sign-in is not affected.
codes.hint: Nothing to do. Tell support if it keeps happening.

codes.title: Not built yet
codes.shopkeeper: This connector is not built yet.
codes.hint: Use the File connector (CSV) or the Counter, and ask for it under Help.

codes.title: Not yet for your country
codes.shopkeeper: This connector is not ready for your country yet.
codes.hint: Use the File connector (CSV) or the Counter.

codes.title: No account
codes.shopkeeper: No account matched. You are only told that sign-in failed.
codes.hint: Check the login and try again.

codes.title: Not signed in as a business
codes.shopkeeper: Sign in as a business to use the network.
codes.hint: Sign in as the business itself.

codes.title: No buyers
codes.shopkeeper: Nobody who got an offer has bought yet.
codes.hint: Look again in a few days.

codes.title: No consent
codes.shopkeeper: They have not agreed to offers from you.
codes.hint: Ask for their consent first.

codes.title: No rules in force
codes.shopkeeper: This installation has no active rules to govern a shop yet.
codes.hint: Tell the platform team.

codes.title: No country set
codes.shopkeeper: This shop has no country set.
codes.hint: Set the country in Country setup.

codes.title: Country not supported yet
codes.shopkeeper: We do not have the rules for this shop's country yet.
codes.hint: Tell us the country. We add countries one at a time.

codes.title: No device
codes.shopkeeper: This device did not say who it is.
codes.hint: Sign in again.

codes.title: No key sent
codes.shopkeeper: No key was sent.
codes.hint: Send the connector key in the X-Bridge-Key header.

codes.title: No lines sent
codes.shopkeeper: Send at least one line.
codes.hint: Add a line and send again.

codes.title: No matching products
codes.shopkeeper: None of those products is sold in this network.
codes.hint: Go back to the store and choose again.

codes.title: No money set
codes.shopkeeper: This shop has not said which money its books are kept in.
codes.hint: Set the money in Country setup.

codes.title: Network has no operator
codes.shopkeeper: This network has nobody to take the order just now.
codes.hint: Tell the store; try again later.

codes.title: No phone
codes.shopkeeper: This person has no phone number, so no offer was sent.
codes.hint: Add a phone number to their card.

codes.title: No PIN set
codes.shopkeeper: No PIN is set yet.
codes.hint: Set your PIN when you sign in.

codes.title: No platform operator
codes.shopkeeper: This installation has no platform operator set up.
codes.hint: Only the platform operator can use this.

codes.title: No price for a line
codes.shopkeeper: A line has no price on the shelf and none was sent.
codes.hint: Set its price on the shelf, or send one.

codes.title: No rows
codes.shopkeeper: There are no rows to import.
codes.hint: Choose a file with at least one lead.

codes.title: No sends
codes.shopkeeper: No offer has been sent yet.
codes.hint: Send one from Groups.

codes.title: Not tied to a shop
codes.shopkeeper: This sign-in is not tied to a shop, so there is nothing to show or change.
codes.hint: Sign in again at the shop's page.

codes.title: No shop copy
codes.shopkeeper: This counter has no copy of your products and prices yet.
codes.hint: Tap Read the shop.

codes.title: No stream named
codes.shopkeeper: Pick at least one stream to hand over.
codes.hint: Choose who carries products, stock or orders, then save.

codes.title: No such network
codes.shopkeeper: There is no network store by that name.
codes.hint: Check the link you were given.

codes.title: No template
codes.shopkeeper: Offers after 24 hours need an approved WhatsApp message.
codes.hint: Set one up in Channels.

codes.title: No message
codes.shopkeeper: Write the message.
codes.hint: Type the message and send again.

codes.title: No token
codes.shopkeeper: WhatsApp is not connected, so nothing went out.
codes.hint: Ask the owner to connect WhatsApp in Channels.

codes.title: Offer clash
codes.shopkeeper: Another live offer already covers some of the same items.
codes.hint: Pause the other offer, or take those items out of this one.

codes.title: Offer ends before it starts
codes.shopkeeper: The offer would end before it starts.
codes.hint: Pick an end after the start.

codes.title: Not confirmed
codes.shopkeeper: This offer is not live yet because you have not confirmed it.
codes.hint: Check what it does and who it is for, then confirm to make it live.

codes.title: Offer not live
codes.shopkeeper: Make the offer live before releasing it to your stores.
codes.hint: Make it live, then release.

codes.title: Offer never released
codes.shopkeeper: That offer was never released to your stores.
codes.hint: Release it first.

codes.title: Offer not known
codes.shopkeeper: That is not an offer.
codes.hint: Pick an offer from the list.

codes.title: Offline
codes.shopkeeper: The shop cannot be reached. Bills are saved here and go when the line is back.
codes.hint: Check the internet.

codes.title: Ok
codes.shopkeeper: Not an error. It means this is allowed.
codes.hint: Nothing to do.

codes.title: Opted out
codes.shopkeeper: They asked not to be messaged on this channel.
codes.hint: Use another way, or leave them.

codes.title: Order is empty
codes.shopkeeper: The order has nothing in it.
codes.hint: Add something to the cart and send it again.

codes.title: Order not accepted
codes.shopkeeper: The shop could not take this order as it is — the reason says which item.
codes.hint: Change that item and send the order again.

codes.title: Origin not allowed
codes.shopkeeper: This address is not allowed to call the service.
codes.hint: Use the shop app, or ask us to allow your address.

codes.title: Otp expired
codes.shopkeeper: That code has expired.
codes.hint: Ask for a new code.

codes.title: Otp locked
codes.shopkeeper: Too many wrong codes were typed.
codes.hint: Ask for a new code.

codes.title: Wrong code
codes.shopkeeper: That code is not right.
codes.hint: Check the code and type it again; the message says how many tries are left.

codes.title: Over the credit limit
codes.shopkeeper: This sale would take the customer past their credit limit.
codes.hint: Ask the owner to allow it, or take a payment first.

codes.title: Owner only
codes.shopkeeper: Only the owner can do this.
codes.hint: Ask the owner of the shop to do it.

codes.title: Pack has no file
codes.shopkeeper: This pack has no file to download.
codes.hint: Build it again, download it, then confirm.

codes.title: Unknown chit page
codes.shopkeeper: That chit page is not one this server knows.
codes.hint: Use a page from the list, or none.

codes.title: Pairing code not known
codes.shopkeeper: That code is wrong or has expired.
codes.hint: Ask ChitBridge for a new code.

codes.title: Too many wrong codes
codes.shopkeeper: Too many wrong codes were tried.
codes.hint: Wait a minute, then ask for a new code.

codes.title: Network not found
codes.shopkeeper: We could not find that network.
codes.hint: Check its handle and try again.

codes.title: DEPRECATED 2026-10-29 (FIN-53): Above the quoted amount
codes.shopkeeper: No longer answered: money above what a bill owes is the books' one question (409 ALREADY_PAID, "More than is owed"), confirmed once as an advance.
codes.hint: Nothing to do; an old client reading this code should ask the 409's warnings instead.

codes.title: The tender is on the bill
codes.shopkeeper: This bill carries its own payment, so it cannot be marked paid here.
codes.hint: Record money received later at the counter, against the bill.

codes.title: Reach figures not ready
codes.shopkeeper: Reach figures are not ready on this server yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Month locked
codes.shopkeeper: That month is locked.
codes.hint: Use a date in an open month, or ask the owner to unlock it.

codes.title: Tax period not closed
codes.shopkeeper: A tax period of that year has not been closed yet.
codes.hint: Close each period named under Tax close, then close the year.

codes.title: Phone delivery not configured
codes.shopkeeper: Codes cannot be sent to a mobile number yet, so nothing was changed.
codes.hint: Try again when text messages are set up.

codes.title: Pin
codes.shopkeeper: Not an error. PIN is the postcode label used in India.
codes.hint: Nothing to do.

codes.title: Only a person can change a PIN
codes.shopkeeper: Only a person with their own login can change a PIN.
codes.hint: Sign in as that person.

codes.title: Current PIN is wrong
codes.shopkeeper: The current PIN is not right.
codes.hint: Try again with your current PIN.

codes.title: Set by the platform
codes.shopkeeper: The platform sets this for every shop.
codes.hint: It cannot be changed here.

codes.title: Policy not known
codes.shopkeeper: The policy must be opt_in or opt_out.
codes.hint: Pick one of the two.

codes.title: Test and live cannot mix
codes.shopkeeper: A test business cannot trade with a real one.
codes.hint: Use a test counterparty.

codes.title: Privacy not set up
codes.shopkeeper: Consent and privacy requests are not set up here yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: The catalogue needs something else
codes.shopkeeper: The catalogue could not take that request, and the sentence says why.
codes.hint: Read the sentence shown, fix it and try again.

codes.title: Clashes with the catalogue
codes.shopkeeper: That clashes with how this catalogue is set up.
codes.hint: Read the sentence shown, fix it and try again.

codes.title: File could not be read
codes.shopkeeper: That file could not be read.
codes.hint: Save it again as a spreadsheet or a CSV and upload it again.

codes.title: The file has problems
codes.shopkeeper: The file has rows that must be fixed first, so nothing was imported.
codes.hint: Fix the rows listed and upload the file again.

codes.title: Product refused
codes.shopkeeper: The catalogue refused that product, and the sentence says why.
codes.hint: Fix what the sentence says and try again.

codes.title: Not set up on this system yet
codes.shopkeeper: This is not set up on this system yet.
codes.hint: Try again later. If it stays, tell us.

codes.title: No catalogue definition
codes.shopkeeper: Your catalogue has no definition to add columns to.
codes.hint: Set up the catalogue first, then try again.

codes.title: Refused by a catalogue rule
codes.shopkeeper: A rule of the catalogue refused that, and the sentence says why.
codes.hint: Fix what the sentence says and try again.

codes.title: Too large for this door
codes.shopkeeper: What you sent is too big for this door.
codes.hint: Send less at a time: split the file, or use a smaller picture.

codes.title: Offers only
codes.shopkeeper: A message to a group is an offer, so it needs their consent for offers.
codes.hint: Send only to people who agreed to offers.

codes.title: Qty ok
codes.shopkeeper: Not an error. Every quantity looked right.
codes.hint: Nothing to do.

codes.title: Group changed
codes.shopkeeper: Someone changed this group since you opened it.
codes.hint: Open the group again and make your change again.

codes.title: Quick key not valid
codes.shopkeeper: A group needs a name, and a key needs a product.
codes.hint: Fill in what is missing and try again.

codes.title: Quick keys need a person
codes.shopkeeper: Quick-key groups are managed by a signed-in person, not by a key.
codes.hint: Sign in as the owner or a manager to change them.

codes.title: Slow down
codes.shopkeeper: Too many requests came in a short time.
codes.hint: Wait the seconds shown, then try again.

codes.title: View only
codes.shopkeeper: Your access is view-only.
codes.hint: Ask the owner for edit access.

codes.title: Refused
codes.shopkeeper: That could not be done as asked.
codes.hint: Read the line shown, change what you sent and try again.

codes.title: Regions not ready
codes.shopkeeper: Regional overrides are not ready on this server yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Registration kind not offered
codes.shopkeeper: That kind of tax registration is not offered in your country.
codes.hint: Pick one of the kinds listed.

codes.title: Already on your list
codes.shopkeeper: They are already on your list.
codes.hint: Open the list to find them.

codes.title: Could not make an id
codes.shopkeeper: We could not give them an id just now.
codes.hint: Try once more.

codes.title: Name not accepted
codes.shopkeeper: That name could not be used to add them.
codes.hint: Type a plain name, not an email, and try again.

codes.title: Say who to add
codes.shopkeeper: Say who to add: a ChitBridge User ID or email, or a name.
codes.hint: Type a User ID, an email or a name and try again.

codes.title: Nothing to change
codes.shopkeeper: You sent nothing to change.
codes.hint: Send at least one field to change.

codes.title: Not on your supplier list
codes.shopkeeper: That business is not on your supplier list, so its catalogue is not shown.
codes.hint: Add them as a supplier first.

codes.title: Not yours to rename
codes.shopkeeper: That is their own business name, so you cannot change it.
codes.hint: Use your own name for them instead.

codes.title: No such business
codes.shopkeeper: We could not find a business with that User ID, bridge ID or email.
codes.hint: Check what you typed, or add them by name instead.

codes.title: Party details not set up
codes.shopkeeper: The party details are not set up here yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Party detail not accepted
codes.shopkeeper: One of the party details was not accepted.
codes.hint: Read the line shown, correct it and try again.

codes.title: Cannot add yourself
codes.shopkeeper: You cannot add your own business to your list.
codes.hint: Choose another business.

codes.title: Repeat needs an answer
codes.shopkeeper: Repeat supply needs one more answer before it can do that.
codes.hint: Read the question shown and answer it.

codes.title: Agreement ended
codes.shopkeeper: This agreement has ended.
codes.hint: Start a new agreement from a bill.

codes.title: Customer only
codes.shopkeeper: Only the customer this agreement is with may do that.
codes.hint: Ask the customer to do it.

codes.title: Run not due
codes.shopkeeper: The next run is not due yet.
codes.hint: Try again on or after the next run date.

codes.title: Repeat not migrated
codes.shopkeeper: Repeat supply arrives after the next update.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Seller only
codes.shopkeeper: Only the shop that made this agreement may do that.
codes.hint: Ask the shop that made it.

codes.title: A reason is needed
codes.shopkeeper: Say why, so the other side can read it.
codes.hint: Write the reason and try again.

codes.title: Repeat refused
codes.shopkeeper: Repeat supply refused that, and the sentence says why.
codes.hint: Fix what the sentence says and try again.

codes.title: Not at that step
codes.shopkeeper: This agreement is not at a step where that can be done.
codes.hint: Open the agreement to see what can be done now.

codes.title: Request timeout
codes.shopkeeper: That took too long, so it was stopped.
codes.hint: Try again in a moment.

codes.title: Required
codes.shopkeeper: Your catalogue requires this column.
codes.hint: Make it optional first, then remove it.

codes.title: Return comes from bills
codes.shopkeeper: Your return is made from your bills, not from these books.
codes.hint: Use the GST page.

codes.title: Network name needed
codes.shopkeeper: Set your User ID, or choose a network name, before building.
codes.hint: Set it in your profile, or send a network name.

codes.title: Network name taken
codes.shopkeeper: That network name is already taken.
codes.hint: Choose another network name.

codes.title: Network name unusable
codes.shopkeeper: Your User ID cannot be a network name.
codes.hint: Change your User ID in Settings first.

codes.title: Said no
codes.shopkeeper: They said no to this.
codes.hint: Leave them be, unless they say yes later.

codes.title: Column not named
codes.shopkeeper: Name the column you want to remove.
codes.hint: Pick a column from the list and try again.

codes.title: Nothing to order
codes.shopkeeper: None of those columns are in your catalogue.
codes.hint: Reload the page and try again.

codes.title: Unknown channel
codes.shopkeeper: The channel must be ERP, IoT or AI.
codes.hint: Pick one of those.

codes.title: Unknown source
codes.shopkeeper: A value can come from the system, the customer, a computation or ChitBridge.
codes.hint: Pick one of those.

codes.title: Unknown column type
codes.shopkeeper: A column is text, number, choice or date.
codes.hint: Pick one of those.

codes.title: Cannot connect to itself
codes.shopkeeper: A business cannot connect to itself.
codes.hint: Choose another business.

codes.title: Sending
codes.shopkeeper: Not an error. Bills are on their way to the shop.
codes.hint: Wait a few seconds.

codes.title: Pictures come from Media
codes.shopkeeper: Pictures and video are added from the product's Media, not by editing the product.
codes.hint: Open the product's Media to add or remove them.

codes.title: Session expired
codes.shopkeeper: Your sign-in has ended.
codes.hint: Sign in again.

codes.title: Session not listed
codes.shopkeeper: We could not sign you in just now.
codes.hint: Try again in a minute.

codes.title: Sign in as a person
codes.shopkeeper: Network offers are managed by a signed-in person.
codes.hint: Sign in as a person, not with a key.

codes.title: Session upgrade
codes.shopkeeper: Your sign-in is out of date.
codes.hint: Sign in again.

codes.title: Shop closed
codes.shopkeeper: This shop is closed and is not taking orders just now.
codes.hint: Try again when the shop opens.

codes.title: Shop refusing
codes.shopkeeper: The shop is turning these bills away. They are kept on this counter.
codes.hint: Tap See what is wrong.

codes.title: Sign-in refused
codes.shopkeeper: That sign-in didn't work. Check the details and try again.
codes.hint: Check the details and try again.

codes.title: Sign in
codes.shopkeeper: CRM opens only for a signed-in person, not for a key.
codes.hint: Sign in with your own login.

codes.title: Sign in first
codes.shopkeeper: Sign in at the store to order.
codes.hint: Sign in with your phone or email, then order again.

codes.title: Sign in as a person
codes.shopkeeper: Sign in as a person to use the ledger.
codes.hint: A counter or device key cannot use the ledger.

codes.title: Feedback message missing
codes.shopkeeper: The feedback has no message in it.
codes.hint: Write what you thought, then send.

codes.title: Name or e-mail missing
codes.shopkeeper: A name and a valid e-mail are needed to start the tour.
codes.hint: Type your name and an e-mail address, then try again.

codes.title: Source authoring not ready
codes.shopkeeper: Catalogue source authoring is not ready on this server yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Acceptance not switched on
codes.shopkeeper: Acceptance is not switched on yet.
codes.hint: Try again after the next update.

codes.title: Took too long
codes.shopkeeper: This took too long and was stopped.
codes.hint: Try again; if it keeps happening, tell us.

codes.title: Storage full
codes.shopkeeper: This counter is nearly out of space, so new bills may not save.
codes.hint: Free up space on this device now.

codes.title: Shop list not ready
codes.shopkeeper: The shop list is not set up on this system yet.
codes.hint: Ask your administrator to finish the update.

codes.title: Form not accepted
codes.shopkeeper: The form could not be sent as it is — the reason says what to fix.
codes.hint: Fix what it names and send it again; if it says try again, wait a minute.

codes.title: Supplies not switched on
codes.shopkeeper: Supplies are not switched on yet.
codes.hint: Ask the operator to run the update, then try again.

codes.title: Bill already recorded
codes.shopkeeper: This bill number is already recorded for that supplier with different lines.
codes.hint: Record a correction, or use a new bill number.

codes.title: Supply not accepted
codes.shopkeeper: This supply, purchase or use could not be recorded as sent.
codes.hint: Read the sentence shown, fix it and send it again.

codes.title: Report not delivered
codes.shopkeeper: Your report did not reach the shop.
codes.hint: Contact the shop another way for now.

codes.title: Suspense not nil
codes.shopkeeper: The suspense account must be nil before the year can close.
codes.hint: Clear the difference in the opening balances.

codes.title: Switched off
codes.shopkeeper: This person is switched off.
codes.hint: Switch them on first.

codes.title: Colleague cannot take tasks
codes.shopkeeper: That colleague cannot take tasks right now.
codes.hint: Pick someone who is active.

codes.title: Colleague needed
codes.shopkeeper: Say which colleague gets the tasks.
codes.hint: Pick a colleague.

codes.title: Tasks to route
codes.shopkeeper: This person still has open tasks.
codes.hint: Send them to the pool or to a colleague first.

codes.title: Tax could not be worked out
codes.shopkeeper: We could not work out the tax just now.
codes.hint: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, tell us the request id.

codes.title: Tax number not accepted
codes.shopkeeper: That tax number is not accepted for your country.
codes.hint: Check the number and try again.

codes.title: Terms update pending
codes.shopkeeper: Terms arrive after the next update.
codes.hint: Try again after the update.

codes.title: The test board needs something else
codes.shopkeeper: The test board could not take that, and the sentence says why.
codes.hint: Read the sentence shown, fix it and try again.

codes.title: Test data missing on this server
codes.shopkeeper: The test cases or records are not on this server yet.
codes.hint: Tell us: the server needs to be deployed again.

codes.title: Not signed in to the test board
codes.shopkeeper: Sign in to use the test board.
codes.hint: Sign in, then try again.

codes.title: Screenshot not stored
codes.shopkeeper: The screenshot could not be kept.
codes.hint: Try again. If it keeps happening, tell us.

codes.title: The test board did not record that
codes.shopkeeper: The test board understood that but cannot record it as it is, and the sentence says why.
codes.hint: Read the sentence shown, fix it and try again.

codes.title: Counter request not valid
codes.shopkeeper: The counter sent something that is missing or not right.
codes.hint: Check what was entered and try again.

codes.title: Bill from another phone
codes.shopkeeper: This bill was made on another phone.
codes.hint: Send it from the phone that made it.

codes.title: Key holds no counter
codes.shopkeeper: This key is not holding a counter.
codes.hint: Open the counter on this PC first.

codes.title: Shop charges no tax
codes.shopkeeper: This shop charges no tax, so no rate is needed.
codes.hint: If that is wrong, check the registration in Country setup.

codes.title: Owner or manager sets the rate
codes.shopkeeper: Only the owner or a manager can set a tax rate.
codes.hint: Ask them to set it once; the sale goes on.

codes.title: Counter request refused
codes.shopkeeper: ChitBridge could not do that.
codes.hint: Read the sentence beside it, then try again.

codes.title: Shop screens only
codes.shopkeeper: Only a shop screen can be changed from the counter.
codes.hint: Pick one of the paired screens.

codes.title: Counter bill not sent
codes.shopkeeper: That counter bill could not be sent as it is.
codes.hint: The counter keeps it; send the rest.

codes.title: Bill number already used
codes.shopkeeper: Another counter already used that bill number.
codes.hint: The bill stays on this counter, unsent; it is given its own number next time.

codes.title: Sign in first
codes.shopkeeper: Sign in as the shop to do this.
codes.hint: Sign in, then try again.

codes.title: Token expired
codes.shopkeeper: Your sign-in has run out.
codes.hint: Sign in again.

codes.title: Token invalid
codes.shopkeeper: Your sign-in is no longer valid.
codes.hint: Sign in again.

codes.title: Token missing
codes.shopkeeper: You are not signed in.
codes.hint: Sign in, then try again.

codes.title: Message too long
codes.shopkeeper: The message is too long.
codes.hint: Shorten it and send again.

codes.title: Too many
codes.shopkeeper: That is too many at a time.
codes.hint: Send fewer, or make a smaller group.

codes.title: Too many groups
codes.shopkeeper: A customer can be in at most 20 groups.
codes.hint: Take them out of one group first.

codes.title: Not claimed yet
codes.shopkeeper: That business has not claimed its place yet, so it cannot say yes.
codes.hint: Ask it to claim its place first.

codes.title: Field not known here
codes.shopkeeper: Not saved: that detail cannot be changed here. Check the name and try again.
codes.hint: Leave that detail out and save again.

codes.title: User ID is the business’s
codes.shopkeeper: A User ID belongs to the business, not to a person.
codes.hint: You sign in as key@business; that cannot be changed here.

codes.title: User ID cannot change
codes.shopkeeper: A User ID cannot be changed once it is set.
codes.hint: Change the business name instead; the User ID stays.

codes.title: User ID not usable
codes.shopkeeper: Choose a User ID that can be used.
codes.hint: Read the sentence shown and try another.

codes.title: User ID taken
codes.shopkeeper: That User ID is already taken.
codes.hint: Choose another; it cannot be changed later.

codes.title: Fields not valid
codes.shopkeeper: Some of what was sent is missing or not valid.
codes.hint: Fix the fields listed and send again.

codes.title: Vault changed
codes.shopkeeper: Changed since you opened it — reload?
codes.hint: Reload the vault, then save again.

codes.title: Vault enc unconfigured
codes.shopkeeper: Secure storage is not switched on yet, so nothing was stored.
codes.hint: Try again when it is switched on.

codes.title: Vault version required
codes.shopkeeper: This screen is older than the vault — reload it, then save.
codes.hint: Reload the screen, then save.

codes.title: Registry check failed
codes.shopkeeper: That registry number could not be confirmed.
codes.hint: Check the number and try again.

codes.title: View only
codes.shopkeeper: Your login can only view.
codes.hint: Ask the owner for edit access.

codes.title: Catalogue visibility closed
codes.shopkeeper: The catalogue cannot be that open for this business.
codes.hint: The sentence names who closed it; ask them.

codes.title: Visibility not migrated
codes.shopkeeper: This database does not accept network visibility yet.
codes.hint: Apply the pending database update, then build again.

codes.title: They withdrew consent
codes.shopkeeper: They withdrew their consent to offers on that channel.
codes.hint: Do not send offers there.

codes.title: Workbook cut
codes.shopkeeper: This sheet is bigger than we read, so only part of it was read and nothing was imported.
codes.hint: Delete unused columns, or split the sheet, and upload again.

codes.title: Work request not valid
codes.shopkeeper: That list request is not valid.
codes.hint: Ask for one view at a time.

codes.title: Staff only
codes.shopkeeper: Sign in as staff to see Tasks and Orders.
codes.hint: Sign in with a staff login.

codes.title: Writer threw
codes.shopkeeper: A sign-in note could not be saved. Your sign-in is not affected.
codes.hint: Nothing to do. Tell support if it keeps happening.

codes.title: Wrong scope
codes.shopkeeper: The key on this counter is not for selling.
codes.hint: Sign in to link it again.

codes.title: Field not valid
codes.shopkeeper: A field has a value of the wrong kind.
codes.hint: Use the kind of value the field asks for.

codes.title: Year closed
codes.shopkeeper: That financial year is closed.
codes.hint: Use a date in the open year.

codes.title: Year cannot close yet
codes.shopkeeper: The year cannot be closed yet.
codes.hint: Read the reasons shown and fix each one.

codes.title: A record both parties hold
codes.shopkeeper: This chit is a record both parties hold, so it cannot be deleted.
codes.hint: Archive it instead.

codes.title: Code already used
codes.shopkeeper: That code was already used.
codes.hint: Use the order that was made the first time.

codes.title: A dispute is open
codes.shopkeeper: A dispute is open on this chit.
codes.hint: Resolve it first.

codes.title: Could not check disputes
codes.shopkeeper: Could not check for open disputes.
codes.hint: Try again in a moment.

codes.title: A reason is needed to reject
codes.shopkeeper: Say why you are rejecting this bill.
codes.hint: Write the reason and try again.

codes.title: Status changed under you
codes.shopkeeper: Someone else just changed this chit.
codes.hint: Look at it again, then try once more.
